Meridian Mirror

Low-iron mirror glass in a steel ring, hung from a single bar that reads as a drawn line rather than a bracket.

$410

Finish
Size

Free shipping over $250 · 30-day returns, postage paid · Nothing on this site can actually be purchased.

Detail

A circle held by a line.

Low-iron glass rather than standard float, so it does not put a green cast on everything it reflects. The hanging bar is structural, not decorative — the ring pivots on it, so the angle is adjustable by hand and holds by friction.

Care. Clean with glass cleaner on a cloth, never sprayed directly at the frame joint.
